observation.visible_scene: A fixed wide shot of a mountain waterfall: a broad white cascade pours over a horizontal rocky ledge into a turquoise plunge pool, set between gray-brown rock walls covered with patches of green moss, shrubs and conifer trees along the top. In the foreground a stream rushes over rounded brown and gray boulders, generating white frothy rapids. A small green text watermark reading 'Healing Nature & Meditation' is overlaid on the right rock face and stays in the same pixel position throughout.
visible_changes: The falling waterfall's white mass continuously re-forms frame to frame, with its frothy texture and edge detail churning while the overall cascade position and width remain constant.
The foreground rapids and foam over the rocks shift and swirl, changing shape and brightness between frames while the underlying boulders stay fixed.
The turquoise pool surface shows subtle ripple motion near the base of the falls.
No camera movement is evident: cliffs, trees, rocks, pool outline and the watermark hold identical positions across all frames, so all change is water motion, not translation or zoom of the view.
outside_clip_unknowns: Upstream source and downstream continuation of the water are not shown.
Audio, lighting changes over longer time, and any events before t=0 or after t=1.33 s are outside this excerpt.
Whether the flow rate is constant or varying beyond the sampled window is not determinable.
uncertain_details: Minor apparent differences in the cascade's silhouette between frames could be real deformation of the falling sheet or sampling artifacts of fast-moving foam; the camera is otherwise clearly static.
No distinct object enters, exits, or occludes another; the scene's structure is persistent and only the water is in motion.
